description: This file defines the SavedNewsDb class responsible for managing a local SQLite database of news articles within a Flutter application. It provides methods for initializing the database, inserting (upserting), deleting, and retrieving news articles stored as NewsArticle objects.

classes.name: SavedNewsDb
classes.description: A class that manages the SQLite database operations for saved news articles, including initialization, insertion (upsert), deletion, and retrieval.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the database if it hasn't been initialized yet; creates the database and the 'News_Table' table if necessary.

methods.name: _database
methods.description: Getter that retrieves the current database instance, throwing an error if the database hasn't been initialized.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts a news article into the database, replacing any existing entry with the same primary key (headline).

methods.name: deleteByHeadline
methods.description: Deletes a news article from the database based on its headline.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all stored news articles, ordered by time descending.
